title: Atlas Edit Weekly Cycle Proposal - Week Of 2026-11-09
headline: Core GovOps submits the weekly Atlas Edit proposal for the week of 2026-11-09: edits include adding weETH as Morpho vault collateral with a 60,000 weETH cap, new Morpho vault governance rules, and monthly grants to the Spark and Grove foundations.
summary: On behalf of Core GovOps, the Atlas Edit Weekly Cycle proposal for the week of 2026-11-09 lists these edits: add weETH as eligible collateral for Morpho vaults with a 60,000 weETH exposure cap shared between Spark and Grove; add a Morpho Vault Curation Governance Process defining which vault changes need governance approval and which need only disclosure, with a change note template; consolidate the rules for Governance Polls into one process definition; replenish the Demand Side Buffer monthly through the Monthly Settlement Cycle and change how its payments are recognized as Expenses; rename audit firm tiers to Category 1 and Category 2, moving OpenZeppelin, ConsenSys Diligence and Trail Of Bits to Category 1; authorize the December 2026 grants to the Spark Foundation and the Spark Asset Foundation; authorize the November 2026 grant to the Grove Foundation; and add CCTP Facet controller functions with an ERC-4626 emergency withdrawal on chains other than Ethereum. The post covers several independent edits to the governing document. Open questions: the exposure limits for weETH and the effect of the new vault governance process.
